'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] announces the death of two [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[hostage]]s and says that eight others have been seriously injured by Israeli [[airstrike]]s on the [[Gaza Strip]] in the past 96 hours. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-armed-wing-says-israeli-strikes-gaza-have-killed-two-israeli-hostages-2024-02-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Myanmar]]'s [[State Administration Council|military junta]] announces that all men aged 18 to 35 and all women aged 18 to 27 will be required to complete two years of [[Conscription|mandatory military service]], amid territorial losses to anti-military junta forces in the ongoing civil war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-enforces-mandatory-military-service-young-people-2024-02-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Two [[Basij]] members are killed in an attack on an outpost in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202402110051 (Iran International)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Maco landslide]]
**The death toll from the [[landslide]] in [[Maco, Davao de Oro]], [[Philippines]], five days ago, increases to 54 people. Sixty-three others are still missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/2/11/death-toll-rises-to-54-in-southern-philippines-landslide (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Lakewood Church shooting]]
**A woman carries out a [[shooting]] at [[Lakewood Church]], [[Houston]], Texas, United States. She is shot and killed by an off-duty [[Houston Police Department|Houston police officer]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2024/02/11/shooting-lakewood-church-joel-osteen/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*A [[drive-by]] [[spree shooting]] in [[California]], [[United States]] kills four people and injures a 13-year-old. All three suspects have been arrested and unharmed. [https://www.gunviolencearchive.org/incident/2826477 (GVA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Finnish presidential election]]
**[[Alexander Stubb]] is elected [[President of Finland]] with 51.6% of the vote.[https://yle.fi/a/74-20074033 (Yle)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 NFL season]]
**[[Super Bowl LVIII]]
***In [[American football]], the [[Kansas City Chiefs]] win the [[Super Bowl]] for the second consecutive year, defeating the [[San Francisco 49ers]] 25–22. The Chiefs are the first team to repeat as Super Bowl champions since 2005. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/american-football/68145318 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2023 Africa Cup of Nations]]
**In [[association football]], hosts [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast]] win their third [[Africa Cup of Nations]] by defeating [[Nigeria national football team|Nigeria]] 2–1 in [[2023 Africa Cup of Nations final|the final]]. [[Sébastien Haller]] scores the winning goal in the 81st minute. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2024/feb/11/nigeria-ivory-coast-african-cup-nations-afcon-final-match-report (''The Guardian'')]
